how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three steps from the market to your registered contribution.
how.step1Body: At Wayna Sopocachi or Wayna Sur, each entrepreneur has a code that opens their profile on this platform.
how.step2Body: Read their story, the campaign goal, and the amount you want to donate in bolivianos.
how.step3Body: Pay via banking QR or cash at the desk; the Wayna team validates and records it in the system.

platform.title: Your Wayna support system
platform.subtitle: The same spirit as the market, with digital records for tourists, cashiers, and administration.
platform.traceBody: Every donation is linked to the entrepreneur, campaign, and payment method for reporting and audit.
platform.touristBody: Public profile, media, campaign goals, and confirmation with payment code and timer.
platform.teamBody: Admin and cashiers manage entrepreneurs, pending donations, and cash confirmation.
